notes: Reports accuracy and service-normalization patch for the Vita Nova Staff Reports Dashboard.

Merges equivalent service labels such as Pantry/Food Pantry, Employment/Employment Services, Health Care/Health Services, Mental Health/Mental Health Services, Clothing/Clothing Closet, and Intake/Outreach so reports compare the same services.
Fixes Requested vs Received By Service so services no longer show false 0% fulfillment when matching received-service records exist under a related label.
Separates event-like labels such as Group Activities and Volunteering @ Spot from service reports so service fulfillment excludes event activity.
Fixes Unsupported Housing classification so Unsupported Housing is not misread as Supported Housing.
Stops journey reports from backdating current stay to first contact and uses earliest reliable dated evidence from check-ins, intake, Sleep Spot, and placement history.
Corrects Joshua Caudill's Unsupported Housing journey date to 01-01-2025 and fixes additional wrong-year imported service/Sleep Spot dates found during audit.

Updates the hosted phone/tablet portal to filter event-like service options and remove Sleep Spot, Group Activities, Living Outside, Homeless Shelter, and shelter-style current-stay options from check-in entry.
Improves Follow-Up Reasons summary rendering so long reason labels do not crowd the chart panel.
Keeps Java 25 bytecode compatibility so Staff secure local services start correctly on staff computers.
